scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.generate-api: cd backend && uv run python -c "import json; from caad_erp.api.app import create_app; print(json.dumps(create_app(skip_lifespan=True).openapi()))" > ../frontend/src/api/openapi.json && cd ../frontend && npx openapi-typescript ./src/api/openapi.json -o ./src/api/schema.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
